full_judgment: "void is meaningless in an absolute sense; and unless the necessary proceedings are taken at law to establish the cause of invalidity and to get it quashed or otherwise upset, it will remain as effective for it's ostensible purpose as the most impeccable of orders; In the words of Lord Diplock, the order would be presumed to be valid unless the presumption was rebutted in competent legal proceedings by a party entitled to sue."
